readerCopy.body: Someone else's refusal to keep following the old rules can expose how much the familiar arrangement depended on their continued cooperation. When Uranus opposes Lilith, disruption and autonomy face each other directly, making the old expectation harder to defend once one side stops agreeing to it. A broader frustration can surface around who was expected to adjust, wait, stay agreeable, or absorb the disruption so everyone else could keep the same arrangement. The change may feel sudden even when the dissatisfaction is not. The situation becomes easier to understand once the old expectation and the cost of maintaining it are named separately.
